articles.title: Against the Current: How Tiny Fish Scale a 50-Foot Waterfall with Velcro Fins
articles.summary: Shellear fish under two inches long climb a 50-foot waterfall in Congo using microscopic hooks on their fins. The exhausting journey can take 10 hours, with many slipping and starting over.

articles.title: The Mermaid Mask: A Murder Mystery Where Every Suspect Is a Lovable Goofball
articles.summary: The Mermaid Mask is a critically acclaimed point-and-click mystery game set on a submarine. With a cast of eccentric suspects and sharp comedic writing, it's one of 2026's best-reviewed games.

articles.title: Mariah Carey's Christmas Classic Breaks Record for Longest Hot 100 Reign
articles.summary: Mariah Carey's "All I Want for Christmas Is You" now holds the record for the most weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100, with 22 weeks. It surpasses hits like "Old Town Road" and "One Sweet Day."
